note: Design record. No schema, migration, route, cron, binding or code exists for it.

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: health dataflows under agency TR (ids UNKNOWN until an authenticated listing; model verified with DF_EMISYON_DEGISIM_ORAN)
rows.auth: Bearer token from giris.tuik.gov.tr (API key from SMS-verified portal account or TÜİK client credentials); secret referenced by name only
rows.release_detection: 1) release calendar page (Veri_Takvimi) due-date; 2) dataflow/DSD version probe; 3) bounded data probe with startPeriod = last checkpoint
rows.revision_strategy: re-pull a revision window (current-year Revision Plan) and diff by value digest; policy pages (Revizyon_Politikasi) inform classification only
rows.raw_artifact_requirement: R0 digest of SDMX-CSV slice; DF/DSD/codelist versions stored on the release
rows.canary_shape: one dataflow, Türkiye series, last 5 periods
rows.expected_failure_modes: AUTH_FAILURE (token expiry/401); SCHEMA_DRIFT (DSD/codelist version bump); documented codelist/TR/all endpoint error; unknown rate limit → conservative budget

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: Sağlık İstatistikleri Yıllığı (edition PDF TR/EN) + numbered Haber Bülteni
rows.access_mode: HTTPS PDF on dosyamerkez.saglik.gov.tr/Eklenti/{id}/0/{file}.pdf; ids discovered from sbsgm release pages
rows.release_detection: poll sbsgm yearbook and bulletin pages (Sept–Jan window); HEAD Last-Modified/Content-Length; new link or new checksum
rows.revision_strategy: same edition + new checksum = revision candidate; table-level diff; edition change = NEW_RELEASE
rows.raw_artifact_requirement: R1 EVIDENCE required (PDF is the only evidence) — durable store prerequisite
rows.activation_gate: terms UNKNOWN; R2 store (or owner waiver); parser golden-table review
rows.canary_shape: bulletin PDF (0.6 MB) → one mortality table, then one yearbook table (hospital beds) with row/column-sum checks
rows.expected_failure_modes: PARSER_FAILURE (layout); SCHEMA_DRIFT (table renumbering); revision notice absent → revision UNKNOWN

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: nested groups: cancer, HIV/AIDS, TB, influenza (weekly), risk-factor survey, TBSA nutrition; unverified: communicable-other, immunization, screening
rows.release_detection: weekly poll of grip.saglik.gov.tr/tr/hir; monthly poll of group index pages; HEAD + checksum (some PDFs replaced in place)
rows.revision_strategy: checksum change at a stable URL = REVISION candidate; new week/year = NEW_RELEASE; revision otherwise UNKNOWN
rows.activation_gate: terms UNKNOWN; Türkiye-runner access; R2 store
rows.canary_shape: latest weekly influenza report → one table; cancer 2022 → one summary table
rows.expected_failure_modes: NETWORK/WAF denial; PARSER_FAILURE; in-place replacement without notice

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: Yıllık ZIP: BLM 3-1 (4/1-a) and 3-2 (4/1-b) accidents & occupational diseases, BLM 4 sickness, BLM 1 insured
rows.release_detection: poll Yıllıklar page for a new GUID link; HEAD + sha256
rows.revision_strategy: revision & error policy: corrections with notice → same year new checksum = CORRECTION candidate
rows.expected_failure_modes: SCHEMA_DRIFT (sheet names with trailing spaces, renamed blocks); HTTP 500 on bare paths; monthly bulletin files not enumerable

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: GHO indicators (3,099); start: WHOSIS_000001 and a whitelist per domain
rows.release_detection: bounded probe on the Date field (verified in records); orderby support verified at canary
rows.revision_strategy: latest-only API → snapshot comparison: re-pull bounded slice, diff digests; versions ARE the snapshot
rows.expected_failure_modes: SCHEMA_DRIFT (Dim1..3 semantics per indicator); retired indicator codes; CDN host change; modelled CI parsing ('74.4 [73.7-75.1]')

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: Indicators API: SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS first; sources 2, 16, 40
rows.release_detection: GET /v2/sources lastupdated per whitelisted source
rows.revision_strategy: per-source lastupdated change → re-pull bounded slice; WDI archive source 57 as hint
rows.expected_failure_modes: indicator deprecation; pagination; lineage: values mostly WHO/UNICEF/UN (mirror, not independent)

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: dataflows: HLTH_CD_ANR, DEMO_MLEXPEC, HLTH_RS_PHYS, hlth_sha11_hf, …
rows.release_detection: dataflow structure probe + JSON-stat `updated` stamp on a bounded query
rows.revision_strategy: latest-only; flags (provisional, estimated, break) preserved; digest diff → revision
rows.expected_failure_modes: SCHEMA_DRIFT (flow restructure); flags handling; geo code vintage (NUTS)

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: WPP indicators: TPopulation(49), PopByAge5AndSex(46), E0(61), IMR(22), U5MR(24), TFR5(19)
rows.auth: token (free, by request) — API returned 401 without it
rows.release_detection: edition watch (manual/poll of the WPP page) — editions are biennial
rows.revision_strategy: new edition = NEW_EDITION with METHODOLOGY_CHANGE at release level; variants as scenario dimension
rows.raw_artifact_requirement: R0 digest; bulk files R1 if later used
rows.expected_failure_modes: AUTH_FAILURE; projection vs estimate confusion (scenario_variant mandatory)

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: SDMX flows: CME, CME_CAUSE_OF_DEATH, MNCH, IMMUNISATION, NUTRITION, HIV_AIDS, WASH_*
rows.release_detection: dataflow version probe + bounded data probe
rows.revision_strategy: latest-only; digest diff
rows.expected_failure_modes: double counting with WHO/UN IGME (CO_OWNED_WITH edge); DSD drift

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: DSD_HEALTH_STAT@DF_LE, DF_COM, DF_C, DF_CD, DSD_SHA@DF_SHA, workforce/hospital flows
rows.release_detection: flow version probe; at most one probe per flow per day
rows.revision_strategy: latest-only; digest diff
rows.activation_gate: CANONICAL_GATED: terms UNKNOWN, conflicting rate limits (20 queries/min + 20 downloads/hr vs 60/hr) → LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED; adapter DISABLED
rows.canary_shape: one flow × TUR × 3 periods once, only after owner/legal clearance
rows.expected_failure_modes: rate limit breach; SCHEMA_DRIFT; terms

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: data.cdc.gov Socrata ids: w9j2-ggv5, e2d5-ggg7, 4bc2-bbpq, it4f-frdc, jx6g-fdh6
rows.release_detection: view metadata rowsUpdatedAt
rows.revision_strategy: latest-only; provisional vs final by dataset; digest diff
rows.activation_gate: terms VERIFIED (US Government Works); owner authorization still required
rows.expected_failure_modes: provisional counts revised; suppression; no Türkiye data (benchmark only)

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: ONS datasets: weekly-deaths-region, weekly-deaths-age-sex, life-expectancy-by-local-authority, health-accounts
rows.release_detection: latest_version id / next_release metadata
rows.revision_strategy: explicit versions → map to releases; revision_class from version notes only if stated
rows.expected_failure_modes: beta API contract change; GSS code vintages

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: INJ_FATL_ECO_NB_A, INJ_NFTL_ECO_NB_A, INJ_FATL_ECO_RT_A, INJ_DAYS_ECO_NB_A, SDG_F881_SEX_MIG_RT_A
rows.access_mode: rplumber CSV API https://rplumber.ilo.org/data/indicator/ ; SDMX https://sdmx.ilo.org/rest/ ; TOC timestamps
rows.release_detection: TOC per-indicator last-update timestamp (weekly bulk refresh, Sundays)
rows.revision_strategy: latest-only; digest diff; relay of national source (lineage note)
rows.expected_failure_modes: counts vs rates; migrant/sex classifications; national-source breaks

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: GBD results (cause × risk × location × age × sex × measure)
rows.access_mode: operator-supplied export file (account login, emailed link)
rows.bounded_unit: GBD round × measure × cause list × location set
rows.release_detection: manual: operator registers a new round/export
rows.revision_strategy: new GBD round = NEW_EDITION; rounds not comparable by default
rows.raw_artifact_requirement: R1 EVIDENCE (export file) if terms permit
rows.expected_failure_modes: modelled estimates; non-commercial restriction

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: GLOBOCAN Cancer Today / Tomorrow
rows.release_detection: manual edition watch
rows.revision_strategy: new edition = NEW_EDITION
rows.activation_gate: terms UNVERIFIED, systematic-retrieval permission UNKNOWN: LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED; adapter DISABLED
rows.expected_failure_modes: modelled estimates; legal

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: AIDSinfo HIV estimates
rows.release_detection: manual (annual July release)
rows.revision_strategy: new release restates history = NEW_EDITION
rows.expected_failure_modes: coverage of Türkiye UNVERIFIED

rows.dataset_or_dataflow: Surveillance Atlas indicators

rows.revision_strategy: member-state resubmissions → digest diff
